ruling: ADR_UGENCE_STUDIO_FRONT_DOOR_SCOPING.md FD-3 COMPOSITION_RECORD_IN_REGISTRY: an ai-system-registry SystemRegistration; immutable and versioned by system_version; supersedes composition-record.seam-6.json; no new package for composition metadata

registration.notes: Front-door composition, seam 7 (FD-1 ONE_SEAM_PER_STEP, FD-11 as ruled: OBSERVE_OVER_WORKER_LEDGER, READ_PORT_IN_CONTROL_PLANE_ROOT, SEVENTH_ROUTE_LEDGER_READ, TWO_LABELLED_SOURCES, READ_ONLY_ONE_STEP_AMENDMENT): build_studio_context receives the same seams as seam 6; the review-service destination now carries seven routes, the seventh a raw read of the worker's own tenant's audit-ledger rows by correlation id (control-plane-root 0.2.0 read_entries, governed-review-service 0.6.0, governed-runtime-worker 0.3.0); the frozen v2 contract is amended a third time (v2-A3) by one read operation; no configuration value, image package, credential or second egress destination is added; decision_store, governance_hook and console_base_url stay absent. Supersedes the seam-6 registration, which is never edited; a later seam registers a new record superseding this one.
